source_evidence:
Exact player 'OK head out. 

We have a few things to follow up on'. Ordinary exit of completed chosen investigation and sharing established identity, no new contested action or commitments. D326~18:35 public street outside Orsaven counting shop, V/Cirren/Fenar reunited; Mara safely at Copper Hart with coach/four horses. Exact player 'OK head out. 

We have a few things to follow up on' authorizes ordinary safe departure from apparently vacant broker office and reunion/briefing, not a further investigation, inn return, expense or new commitment. V leaves already examined original records in original positions, descends the same rear service stair and exits, draws door closed without claiming relocked or perfect concealment; no observed occupant, alarm, obstruction or detection, no additional uncertainty/check on this exit. V shares actual House Veldrake identification and shows his own handwritten notes to Cirren/Fenar. Both informed; Mara not yet briefed. V keeps handwritten notes, Cirren keeps two original papers in satchel; no new originals taken. Apron/cap still worn, no further clothing changes. Psychic Whispers link with Cirren/Fenar through23:05. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup3/4 Psi3/6 MP6/7 PastLife2/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers0/1 cloak+Luckstone; Cirren51/51 AC19 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots +1Shield no concentration; Fenar59/59 AC16 HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40 breastplate/Insignia natural+9/1d6+6 base or1d6+8 raging mechanical greataxe unchanged. Purse2049gp8sp6cp, rations21/feed28, LR0/6; surveillance and investigation not rest. Evidence retained: Cirren original lot27 invoice36gp from storehouse2, matching observed case transferred from storehouse1, joint freight account; original sealed acknowledgement 'Received fourteen gold pieces for information supplied concerning the forthcoming berth inspections. I shall continue to represent your interests in the matter of selective inspection exemptions.' Broker identified seal as Noldren Tavosk, commercial petition delegate public office Exchange district, no personal meeting. V witnessed payment to landing official and ferry transfer/sale; saw D3206gp + D3238gp fee entries and route-broker reimbursement column in warehouse1, left those originals. V's notes faithfully transcribe broker ledger Lot27 inward lighter/ferry Storehouse1→2 sale36gp; D321 household agent instruction 'My patron approves the previous arrangement. Continue supplying lace from the consignments landed before assessment. No assessed duties are to appear on our bill. Charge to private household account L-9.' D322 broker receipt24gp from household purchasing agent, agent stamp sketch, matching client index entry 'L-9 — House Veldrake — private household purchasing account; correspondence through household purchasing agent.' These notes are not certified original exhibits; actual patron individual, broker personal name, current locations, ultimate proceeds and knowledge of Quenwood's killings remain unresolved. No demonstrated involvement of other actors in murders, enacted exemptions, 250gp patron investment or new meeting. Actual paymaster48gp retained, promised notification to Sgt Rill Desen/restitution authority not verified sent; no actual restitution allocation. Quenwood life sentence upheld/assets frozen. Cirren favors bringing evidence to Desen and appropriate customs officials for bounded inquiry, with actual V decision pending; no new action assumed. Skiff freed/jelly defeated, Meret referral delivered, no employment or business agreement. Royal councillor favorable recommendation and confidential Kestrel copies complete, royal decision pending, no treaty or policy change; separate Crown frontier intelligence commission300+1300 contingent, Orseld lead requires corroboration. Western service-house conditional recovery grant signed not title, route48road+12rough miles (~3days each way); Coris packet forwarding/300gp assessment pending, optional800 field milestone. Magic orders balance520 target353 actual delivery pending; Elara Caereth, Severin assent unconfirmed. All other obligations/custody unchanged. V dice delegated. Await V's next chosen follow-up; no time skip, rest, spend or automatically delivered report.
